elements.evidence: the Hosting Services and Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner

elements.evidence: professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards
will conform in all material respects to its documentation and specifications

a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Interface, software or services
TrueLink will comply in all material respects with all laws applicable to its performance
free of viruses, worms, Trojan horses and other malicious code
twelve (12) months following delivery — a preferred-only amount, not the fallback 90 days
no services warranty period appears anywhere in the inserted text
repair or replacement, or a refund of the fees paid
performed in a professional and workmanlike manner
conform in all material respects to its documentation

reasons: Preferred level incomplete: the insertion supplies no services warranty duration at all (no 90 days from performance/completion), so the Services conformance leg and its period are absent.
Conformance is diluted to 'in all material respects', whereas the preferred (and fallback) position requires conformance to documentation without a materiality qualifier.
Fallback is also not satisfied: it needs 90 days for software and 30 days for services; the draft uses the preferred-only 12-month software figure and states no services period.

Non-minimal additions beyond what the level requires: 'consistent with industry standards', 'and specifications', the added 're-performance' remedy, and the vendor-elective 'at TrueLink's option' (the required remedy set is repair, replacement, refund).

Fix: add '(b) for a period of ninety (90) days following performance, the Hosting Services and Support Services will conform to their documentation', delete 'in all material respects', 'consistent with industry standards', 're-performance' and 'at TrueLink's option'.
Unrelated Y2K warranty, access/repair mechanic and disclaimer paragraph remain intact; no undefined terms or dangling mechanics introduced.
